stories.headline: Black Friday: rival AR glasses on sale — XREAL One Pro $499, RayNeo GT $249
stories.subtitle: Competitors are discounting too: XREAL's One Pro is $499 (from $599) and RayNeo's GT is $249 through Nov 30, with Rokid's AI Glasses Style at $279. Expect price-comparison questions — Meta's own sale leaves Gen 3 and the Display at full price.

stories.headline: Steam Frame is now the 5th most used PC VR headset
stories.subtitle: Valve's Steam Frame hit 5.49% of PC VR headsets in October's Steam survey — fifth overall after one full month on sale, ahead of Pico 4. Quest 3 still leads at 27%. Expect customers comparing the Frame to Quest to cite this.

stories.headline: Meta details hands-first strategy for its spring 2027 VR Glasses
stories.subtitle: Meta told developers its $1,299.99 VR Glasses, due spring 2027, will lean on seated, hands-first navigation, with media and entertainment ahead of motion-controlled gaming. Early guidance on how the next headset will actually be used.

stories.headline: Apple smart glasses reportedly set for WWDC 2027 debut
stories.subtitle: Bloomberg reports Apple's first smart glasses will debut at WWDC 2027 and ship later that year — slimmer than Ray-Ban Meta Gen 2, with cameras and an agentic Siri, but no display. Expect "should I wait for Apple?" questions.

stories.headline: Gentle Monster's Android XR batch sells out; Warby Parker ships Dec 8–27
stories.subtitle: Gentle Monster's first batch of Android XR glasses sold out by Nov 16, while Warby Parker pre-orders ship Dec 8–27 ahead of the Dec 10 on-sale date. Frames start at $395 (Warby Parker) and $449 (Gentle Monster) — the first real rival to Ray-Ban Meta.
